// transcendental_logp1 -- lnp1(x) = ln(1 + x), log2p1, log10p1 (IEEE 754-2019 §9.2), all five rounding
// directions (LogP1ExpM1WorkOrder.md LP-8). Generated by
// workorder/d48-prototype/logp1_expm1_phase0.py gen-rosetta (seed 31).
// Native dialect: <op> <MODE> <args> -> <result> [flags]; flags x inexact, u underflow,
// o overflow, i invalid, z divideByZero. Results are the correctly rounded decimal128 value
// from Python decimal at 140 and 280 digits (which must agree), not from a port; |x| < 10^-60
// uses x ∓ x²/2 exactly, and the log family above 10^30 ln x + log1p(1/x) with the tail kept.
// Exact results (LP-4): ±0 keeps x; log10p1 / log2p1 at 1 + x = base^k give k at exponent 0;
// exp10m1 at an integer k with |k| <= 34 gives 99…9 (exponent 0) or −0.99…9 (exponent k).
// Inputs: specials and zeros, hand vectors (tiny rules, the 10^-5 switch edges, x near −1,
// huge x, the exact cases and their ±1-ulp neighbours, x = 10^k (RP), the overflow and −1
// edges, exp10m1's integer exit), the R2 / RN rule families, and a sweep of the whole domain.
// `// gap:` lines are the documented 1-ulp gap (CrossPlatformArchitecture.md §12), with the
// D48 answer every port must give.
// 285 special, 21005 active, 0 gap.
// --- lnp1: specials and zeros (95), then hand vectors, rule families and the sweep (10375 active, 0 gap)
